scope: Isolated loopback Go endpoint and production Snoot UI in WebKit; 10,000 synthetic unsealed events in one branch.
measurement: View-worker elapsed time includes collection, local matching and aggregate preparation; excludes bootstrap and UI painting. Server time is handler wall time. Byte counts are HTTP response bodies, excluding HTTP/TLS headers. Repeat includes two overlap records; arrival includes those two records and one new event. These are not WAN or pre-framework benchmarks.
comparison: The PAC response reduces first-pull bytes from 1,007,812 to 344,384 and one-arrival bytes from 807 to 428. First-pull worker time rose from 101 ms to 197 ms; this is a measured cold-path cost, not a speed improvement.
